home.heroTitle: We care for the earth by educating those who will inherit it
home.heroSubtitle: From San Carlos to Costa Rica and the world.

story.title: Our story begins with a river
story.paragraph1: Abuela Ecológica Foundation was born in the Northern Zone of Costa Rica, on the banks of a river that was losing its forest.
story.paragraph2: At 80 years old, Mrs. Bertalia González decided not to stand by. She began germinating seeds at home and reforesting the riverbanks with native species where life had once flourished.
story.paragraph3: She did not do it for recognition. She did it for the animals, for the land, and for those who had not yet been born.
story.quote: “We must plant trees to leave life for the children who have not yet been born.”
story.closing: For San Carlos, Costa Rica and the world.

aboutStory.title: The Ecological Grandmother
aboutStory.p1: The Abuela Ecologica Foundation was born inspired by the legacy of Bertalia González Villalobos (1935–2020), a community leader in reforestation and water protection.
aboutStory.p2: With seeds in her hands and conviction in her heart, she traveled through communities planting trees as an act of intergenerational responsibility.
aboutStory.p3: In 2018, together with her daughter Laura Alfaro González and her granddaughter María Murillo Alfaro, that legacy became a foundation.
